info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v1-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Returns API enables businesses to efficiently manage the return process for car rental reservations. With this API, users can retrieve detailed information about reservations that are marked for return, allowing for streamlined operations and inventory management. Typical consumers include car rental agencies, fleet managers, and customer service representatives who need to track reservation status and returns. This API plays a crucial role in enhancing customer experience by providing timely updates and insights into reservation logistics.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the return status of a reservation. It provides insights into the return process and current state of the reservation, enabling users to manage their returns effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details for returning a reservation. It must conform to the specified schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content to return.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to reservations. It is expected to be a string.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsResponse.title: Reservation Operations Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsResponse.description: Schema representing the response for reservation operation requests.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the reservation.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit details related to the reservation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time taken to process the request before sending the response.
